opening.argument: The video presents MEV as an educational explanation of different DeFi mechanisms, beginning with an explanation of “the difference in these types of things” and using exchange-based arbitrage as an example of buying on one exchange and selling on another for profit. It also describes front-running and sandwich trading as mechanisms, but the speaker expressly limits personal involvement, stating, “I don't do front running myself,” and that they do not personally like the sandwich technique. The bootcamp references offer further step-by-step education, without describing guaranteed financial returns, required viewer payment, or deceptive conduct.
